headline.purpose: Page and primary card titles. Fixed rem, never fluid.

label.purpose: Mono uppercase column headers and metric keys. Data labels only, never section eyebrows.

data.purpose: Mono tabular figures: amounts, scores, deltas.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Card hover/focus only, paired with translateY(-2px). Signals interactive/selected.

shadows.name: action-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary-button hover only. The one place brand green blooms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action. Confident and tactile: deepens and glows on hover, presses on active.

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Paper surface + rule-line border, hovers to a sprout-green-tinted surface.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field. Paper bg, rule-line border, green focus ring, no glow.

components.name: Card
components.description: Content surface. Flat at rest (border defines it), lift on hover only.

components.name: ESG Score Badge
components.description: Signature component. Pill chip mapping a 0-100 score to a tone band; ALWAYS shows the number (color never the sole signal).
components.html: 81 54 28

components.name: Comparison Delta
components.description: Signature voice. Always rendered with its comparison period; green down-arrow for improvement, destructive up-arrow for regression, both with text.

narrative.overview: SST is the field notebook of someone observing their own spending: precise, annotated, data-forward, and quietly honest. The numbers are the subject; the interface is the ruled paper they sit on. Monospaced labels and tabular figures give it the feel of an instrument readout, not a marketing dashboard. The notebook has one warm habit: it roots for the reader, printing the full comparison (down 12% vs abril) and, on a good month, a small green ground note. It motivates, it never moralizes.
keyCharacteristics: Data-forward: monospaced figures and labels, tabular alignment, the number is the hero.
Restrained green, committed where it counts: data viz and primary actions, never decoration.
Flat at rest, responsive to touch: surfaces defined by borders, depth is a reaction to state.
One warm note: positive reinforcement and full-context comparisons, nowhere else.
WCAG 2.1 AA, color never the only signal.

rules.name: The Color-Plus-Number Rule
rules.body: Every ESG value shows its number inside the colored chip; color is never the sole carrier of meaning.

rules.name: The Committed-Restraint Rule
rules.body: Green carries data viz and primary actions and nothing else. It may dominate a chart but never tints chrome, nav, or card backgrounds.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every figure in a column or that updates in place uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums in the mono face.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Uppercase mono is for data labels and column headers only; never a tracked kicker above section headings.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; the border is the boundary. A shadow appears only as a response to state.

dos: Do render every currency figure, score, and delta in the mono face with tabular-nums.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and introduce the Lift shadow only on hover/focus.
Do show the numeric score inside every ESG chip; color annotates, never carries meaning alone.
Do write deltas with their comparison period and use the green Ground Note to celebrate a good month.
Do keep green committed to data viz and primary actions; let it dominate a chart, never the chrome.
Do verify body and placeholder text hits 4.5:1 in both light and dark mode.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce fallback.
donts: Don't use crypto-bro neon: no neon gradients, no glassmorphism-by-default, no gradient text, no purple glow.
Don't drift toward the rigid corporate bank: no navy-and-gold, no stock smiling-people photos, no cold legal-dense walls of text.
Don't use the saturated AI default cream/sand/beige body background.
Don't build the hero-metric template or endless identical card grids.
Don't put a tracked uppercase eyebrow above sections; uppercase mono is for data labels only.
Don't use border-left/border-right > 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't tint chrome, nav, or card backgrounds green.
Don't signal error with a red border alone; always pair with a text message.
